name: Zhe Jiang Kangsheng Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhe Jiang Kangsheng Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of refrigeration pipelines and accessories, and new energy commercial vehicles in China and internationally. The company offers refrigeration steel, aluminum, and copper tubes, pipes, and accessories; air-conditioning, and microchannel heat exchanger products and parts; aluminum sheets; and condensers and evaporators for household, and commercial and automotive use.
